## Beta lifecycle integration audit — 2026-10-14 KST

Current head: `c2263e4c90bffb9a56cc41285ebf8207e641b3aa` (tree `570c3700e7bea60df58d6c3efb28e5095a70aa42`).

Compared #62 `5c858442d0ed8360703e0ce63241a567736608a9` with the pre-correction #68 source `ec47f6c09349af9ee5c1b6aa11a287432610b7ef`: #62 is an ancestor; 22 of its 35 changed files are byte-identical, and the remaining 13 were inspected. No missing runtime lifecycle, state-preservation, updater, packaging or publisher protection was found. The historical restore test retains all 4,967 released parameter identities/values and adds default checks for the 19 tuner + 40 dynamics parameters.

The actual omission was stale documentation: the manual, update guide and release notes still described #62's unapproved beta.3 policy. This head corrects that wording and the review marker's explanation only; runtime code, policy JSON, tests and gate logic are unchanged. #62 remains unapproved. Only 1.3.2-beta.1 uses **2027-02-11 23:59 KST / 2027-02-11T14:59:00Z**. Cross-version policy/metadata mixing and synthetic publication were rejected in focused checks.

[Audit and comparison](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/blob/c2263e4c90bffb9a56cc41285ebf8207e641b3aa/docs/BETA_LIFECYCLE.md#integration-audit--october-14-2026) · [Hashes and evidence](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/blob/c2263e4c90bffb9a56cc41285ebf8207e641b3aa/docs/evidence/beta-lifecycle-integration-20261014/audit.json)

Validation: 94 local Python lifecycle/publisher/approval checks and pure C++ policy PASS; public-document scan and manual script syntax PASS. Local packaging: 18 PASS, one CMake-unavailable environment error, three Windows-only skips. The audited ec47f6c lifecycle run passed all seven jobs (three-OS runtime and historical restore; macOS state restore five consecutive times). Downloaded Linux artifact digest and approved compiled identity/fingerprint verified.

**Publication remains BLOCKED.** The complete ec47f6c workflow set finished **11 success / 1 failure**: macOS full CTest failed EQ decay, room cabinet lane and tuner acquisition (52/55 passed); the gate was **7 PASS / 121 BLOCKED**, and candidate assembly was skipped. Earlier in-progress text below is historical. This documentation correction changes the embedded manual/source identity: prior native/package evidence is not a PASS for the new head; fresh CI and separate release acceptance are required. `RELEASE_REVIEW_PENDING` and `release_approved=false` remain. No released beta, tag, asset, feed or user data was changed.

#62 stays open as a Draft with its branch/evidence. Consider superseded closure after the audited successor is merged and traceable, without equating closure with release approval.

---

## Historical implementation and qualification record — ec47f6c

This candidate integrates the owner's requested 1.3.2 signal/tuner/dynamics release and fixes the reproduced macOS EQ assertion, stale tuner observations, resumed-input window reuse, and redundant POST arithmetic. Publication/deployment is authorized, but acceptance is not yet complete.

Audited pre-correction product source: `ec47f6c09349af9ee5c1b6aa11a287432610b7ef`  
Tree: `a1bf5a283695942ba8eb8819d8acec25355be4c8`

### Changes
- Integrates the PRE / HEAD / CAB / TONE EQ / POST / FINAL EQ navigation, tuner workspace, focused EQ/analyzer/snapshot editing, four dynamic EQ slots, clean compressor, DI gate/expander and output limiter. Released parameter identities/indices are retained.
- Includes #69 as a merge parent. The tuner worker runs at normal priority; observations retain actual input arrival age and expire at the reader. After an expired gap, the worker clears retained history and the pending FIFO snapshot before reacquiring fresh input. A new block cannot revive old history.
- Makes the tuner panel opaque and localizes dynamic repainting. AUDIO/PEAK continue to report callback deadline usage without clamping or hiding spikes.
- Caches invariant POST gain/exponential/filter calculations while retaining every DSP/meter history update. The frozen pre-cache oracle verifies exact output, including automation, model/bypass transitions, reset and re-prepare.
- Compares the reused EQ node with its canonical host-normalized default and separately bounds physical neutrality; no DSP or performance threshold is changed.
- Uses the owner-approved beta expiry **2027-02-11 23:59 KST / 2027-02-11T14:59:00Z**. Approval is version-specific and does not retroactively approve earlier qualification-only packages.

### Earlier qualification snapshot
Ten focused workflows are SUCCESS at this source: signal/UI/early DSP, graphical EQ, CAB realtime, CAB panel, amp head, beta lifecycle/state preservation, Niflheimr measurements/audition, upgrade compatibility and publisher contracts. As of 2026-10-14 03:30 UTC, Open Beta Windows/Linux compilation and Windows candidate compilation have passed and their full CTest suites are running; the macOS universal build is still compiling. These unfinished jobs are not recorded as PASS.

All three platforms pass 32 new-estimator routes with baseline comparisons, 108 kernel comparisons, 576 accuracy cases, 18 stress cases and the expanded three-scenario stall/mixed-queue/reacquisition regression. The existing <290 ms / <0.1 ct limits are unchanged.

| Platform | Max acquire | Max settle | Max final route error | Worker + POST artifact |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Windows | 204.44 ms | 206.99 ms | 0.00005145 ct | [11865469394](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38500448267/artifacts/11865469394) |
| Linux | 197.48 ms | 205.13 ms | 0.00005145 ct | [11866255663](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38500448267/artifacts/11866255663) |
| macOS | 281.61 ms | 243.41 ms | 0.00010018 ct | [11866690508](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38500448267/artifacts/11866690508) |

Each platform also passes the POST suite: **1,028,160 exact audio-sample comparisons plus meter histories**, all nine models, 64 audio controls, three meter controls, 288 stress blocks, stereo/bypass/latency and spatial controls. Local POST allocation interception: 1,080 callbacks, zero allocation/free calls. The standalone early DSP job adds these POST checks without removing the full UI/package checks.

All three worker ZIP digests and embedded source identities were verified:
- Windows: `aabab0797d6dce778762a41dea659e13030a70924f600435d6b5988407bafbe4`
- Linux: `3dfbc93cfff9eb59a737fc41ca3111da870d78943fcf509d467735bc60bc4932`
- macOS: `91818ad27390d213b3fad3d400d8d9acc9c76845052ea0d32f5e26b8c708a0bd`

### Retained failures and limits
The local full native run for the final gap correction **failed 3/32 routes**. Those raw rows are retained, not retried away or waived. The failures did not reproduce in the first Windows/Linux/macOS CI attempts; their cause is not established. Controlled old-code failures and corrected-code passes are retained in:
- `docs/evidence/132-realtime-fix-20261014/`
- `docs/evidence/132-tuner-input-age-20261014/`
- `docs/evidence/132-tuner-gap-20261014/`
- `docs/evidence/132-post-cache-20261014/`

The narrow local POST benchmark retains all 48 pairs: 96k/64 median section cost was 11–32% lower; one 48k case was 1% slower. This is not a full-callback causal or realtime qualification. Historical b993771 macOS callback observations remain available in [artifact 11865990966](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38499144399/artifacts/11865990966); its canceled workflow is not a green UI/package result.

**Callback overruns remain at the current source**, as detailed below. These are normal-priority synthetic observations, not an audio-driver/DAW run. No physical-instrument accuracy, realtime safety, signing/notarization or real-host acceptance claim is made.

Publication is blocked pending the full source/package results and existing source/version acceptance requirements. `RELEASE_REVIEW_PENDING` and `release_approved=false` remain. The prior 1.3.1-beta.2 acceptance is not carried into this new scope. Existing released tags/assets are unchanged.

Implementation and constraints: `docs/RELEASE_1_3_2_CANDIDATE.md`, `docs/PRECISION_TUNER.md`, `docs/COMMON_DYNAMICS_1_3_2.md`.

### Full integration and current callback evidence
Current ec47f6c Windows full integration: PASS, 11 CTest cases, zero failures/errors (signal-path run 38500448267, job 115646653446). Artifact 11866845120; verified SHA-256 3ab7d575ee3f0580fe62bec5fe56e193ed20c936d68f2b7bc11e4e76b4b087f1. Timing provenance verifies clean ec47f6c source and binary/source match. Reviewed the actual 100% tuner screenshot; no clipping/overlap was observed. Native tests cover 75–150% bounds.

Current Windows callback observations (normal-priority synthetic feeder, NOT_ASSESSED, no driver/DAW; 3,200 measured callbacks per grouped setting, all warmup rows retained):

Windows records thread cycles, not thread CPU microseconds; no cycles-to-time conversion or scheduler-only attribution is made. 96k/64 visible-editor overruns remain and prevent claiming complete callback resolution. Real-host configuration/evidence is still missing.


Current ec47f6c full signal/UI integration workflow is SUCCESS on all three platforms (run 38500448267). macOS: 11 tests, zero failures/errors; artifact 11867180335 SHA-256 761a18d281826de625e33200e9af7a6d426092481ed7dd743d41e251ff22fb0f. Linux: 12 tests including native focus, zero failures/errors; artifact 11867570119 SHA-256 7408b233f526de2129d9c731c73bfddf0d6a343a9fcb1842f3abfd544246b297. Both ZIP digests and clean exact-source/binary provenance verified.

No cause is assigned without further evidence, and no data/threshold is hidden or changed. Publication remains blocked under the existing acceptance requirements while real Studio One/audio-device configuration and host evidence are missing.
